contract: The page must expose window.game.state() returning { player: {x, y}, tiles: { 'x,y': { crop, stage } }, inventory: { seeds, crops }, day }.

steps.name: loads with no page or console errors and exposes state
steps.expect: errors.length === 0 && state && state.player && typeof state.player.x === 'number' && typeof state.player.y === 'number' && state.tiles && state.inventory && typeof state.inventory.seeds === 'number'

steps.name: p on an empty tile with seeds available creates a crop and spends exactly one seed
steps.expect: (function(){ const k = state.player.x + ',' + state.player.y; const t = state.tiles[k]; return !!t && !(before.tiles || {})[k] && t.crop !== undefined && t.crop !== null && state.inventory.seeds === before.inventory.seeds - 1; })()

steps.name: p again on the SAME tile leaves the state unchanged - no second crop, no second seed spent
steps.expect: (function(){ const k = state.player.x + ',' + state.player.y; return state.inventory.seeds === before.inventory.seeds && JSON.stringify(state.tiles) === JSON.stringify(before.tiles); })()

steps.name: with the seeds exhausted, p leaves the state unchanged
